title: War Between the Dining Room and the Kitchen

scenes.title: The Remade Salad and the Eternal Rivalry
scenes.summary: Max describes the rivalry between the dining room and the kitchen as a fussy guest sends back an oily salad, which Max pretends to remake before Chef Barinov catches him.

scenes.title: The Broken Restroom and Vika's Ban
scenes.summary: When the staff restroom breaks down, Vika catches Senya using the guest restroom in the dining room and bans the cooks from entering, sparking a war with Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: An Admirer for Mister Oguzok
scenes.summary: While the waitresses and cooks bicker over the restroom, Kostya informs Max that the older female guest has returned and is asking specifically for him.

scenes.title: Max the Magician and Nagiyev's Check-In
scenes.summary: Max personally serves his dish to the older female guest, who calls him a magician, while Nagiyev sits down with Vika at the bar to check on the restaurant.

scenes.title: The Arthouse Movie Script
scenes.summary: Nagiyev shows off a script for a new arthouse film he hopes to star in and tries to explain a surreal scene about a man named Carlos on a raft by a waterfall.

scenes.title: In Character and an Unexpected Coffee
scenes.summary: Nagiyev explains why he is walking around in costume to get into character for the director, and is surprised when a waitress brings him a coffee he never ordered.

scenes.title: Restroom Clash and the Regular Client
scenes.summary: Vika catches Chef Barinov trying to use the dining room restroom and demands he stop the circus, while Kostya teases Max for satisfying his older regular client in two minutes.

scenes.title: The Stop-List and the Guest's Confession
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov retaliates against Vika by banning waitresses from the kitchen and putting dishes on the stop-list, while the older guest hints to Max that she comes there just to see him.

scenes.title: Kostya's Advice and the Envelope with an Address
scenes.summary: Flustered after the older woman praises his strong hands, Max tells Kostya at the bar that she is hitting on him, and Kostya urges him to go for it before handing him her note.

scenes.title: A Late Banquet for the Waitresses
scenes.summary: Just as the cooks are packing up to go home, Vika orders the kitchen to prepare a late dinner for eight VIP guests—who turn out to be Vika and her waitresses.

scenes.title: Nagiyev Joins the Late Dinner
scenes.summary: Before Chef Barinov can explode at Vika and the waitresses, Nagiyev walks in and asks to join their late meal, ordering one more salad from the kitchen.

scenes.title: Revenge by an Old Recipe
scenes.summary: Assuming the extra salad is for Vika, Chef Barinov and the cooks load it with disgusting ingredients, only for Nagiyev to eat it and storm into the kitchen in a fury.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Warning Before the Director's Visit
scenes.summary: Furious over the ruined salad, Nagiyev lines up the staff and warns both Vika and Chef Barinov that if anyone messes up during the famous director's visit, they will regret it.

scenes.title: The Note Prank and Maxim Galkin
scenes.summary: Dressed up with flowers, Max goes to the address from the envelope expecting his wealthy admirer, only to find Kostya, Senya, and Fedya waiting to photograph and mock him.

scenes.title: The Waitresses' Strike and the Smell of Victory
scenes.summary: To punish the kitchen, Vika arranges for all the waitresses except Nastya to skip their shift, leaving the dining room in chaos as she gloats to Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: Dining Room Crisis and the Director's Arrival
scenes.summary: As angry guests complain about slow service with only Nastya waiting tables, the famous female film director arrives and Nagiyev rushes over to welcome her.

scenes.title: A Method for Working with Actors
scenes.summary: Nagiyev lavishes compliments on the visiting film director, who reveals she has been dining at Claude Monet incognito for two weeks to observe how people act in real life.

scenes.title: Chatting with a Guest and an Offer to Wait Tables
scenes.summary: The director chats in Russian with her foreign companion Luca while Chef Barinov suggests that Max put on a waiter's apron and go serve the dining room.

scenes.title: The Cooks March into the Dining Room
scenes.summary: Kostya comforts Max after the prank, and to save the lunch service during Vika's waitress strike, Chef Barinov sends all his cooks into the dining room to serve the dishes themselves.

scenes.title: Nagiyev Spots the Cooks on the Floor
scenes.summary: Stunned to see line cooks serving tables in front of the film director, Nagiyev drags Chef Barinov and Vika aside and learns that none of the waitresses came to work.

scenes.title: End of the War and a Role for the Chef
scenes.summary: Nagiyev orders Vika and Chef Barinov to end their feud immediately, while the film director reveals to Viktor Petrovich that his fiery outburst won him the role instead of Nagiyev.
